regime.summary: Last MPC move was a hike and CPI is still rising, so the hiking phase is not shown to be over. The market has fallen hard over a month, which gives a rebound chance, but the pack shows no tradable base rate for index shocks (about 50% at 60 sessions) and no rate-cut trigger. Stay light.
